item.description:
Meeting Memory 0.3.2

  • Shows permission recovery guidance in Settings instead of repeating error dialogs on launch.
  • Stops retrying failed screen-access requests automatically.
  • Keeps the same signed app identity for updates.

If macOS retains an entry from an older test version, follow the permission recovery steps in Settings. No recording starts during an access check.

Meeting Memory 0.3.1

  • Checks Screen & System Audio Recording access through ScreenCaptureKit when Grant access is selected, so a stale legacy permission check no longer blocks authorized capture.
  • Uses authorized ScreenCaptureKit window information for meeting detection when the legacy check disagrees.
  • Shows a clear up-to-date status after checking for updates.

If screen recording still shows Grant access, select it once to verify access with macOS. No recording starts during this check.

Meeting Memory 0.3.0

  • Adds Check for Updates and optional automatic update checks.
  • Defers update restarts while recording, transcribing, or delivering a meeting.
  • Uses a stable Apple Developer ID and signed update downloads.
  • Includes improved Webex direct-call detection.

For an older unsigned test version, quit Meeting Memory and replace the app in Applications once. macOS may request permissions again during this transition. Recordings and settings remain in their existing locations. Future releases can be installed through Check for Updates.

Requires macOS 15 or later on Apple silicon. Obtain participant consent before recording.
